question: Which action best keeps the character alive and moves it toward the objective this turn?
text:
RULES:
Lane Runner rules.
The level is one row of tiles numbered 0 to 9. The character stands on one tile.
One action per turn:
- left: step one tile toward 0. A wall tile or a closed door blocks it.
- right: step one tile toward 9. A wall tile or a closed door blocks it.
- dodge: crouch for this turn. Every projectile that reaches or passes the character's tile this turn flies over it.
- wait: stand still.
The character acts first, then each projectile moves 2 tiles in its direction. A projectile that reaches or passes the character's tile hits it unless it dodged. A hit costs 1 HP; at 0 HP the run ends.
Standing on a coin's tile picks it up. Reaching the exit tile ends the level.
A pit can be crossed only on its moving platform, boarded when the platform is at the near edge. Stepping into the pit without it ends the run.
